audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Steadfast Presence as matchup-defining but gives no actual cooldown number, so a reader can't time the window.
audit.why: Poppy's W (Steadfast Presence) is 20/18/16/14/12s and Galio's W (Shield of Durand) is 18/17/16/15/14s — both are punish windows worth stating in numbers.
audit.corrected: Added the real ranked cooldowns for both W's.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing in the page states that Poppy's R (Keeper's Verdict) makes her untargetable through the channel, so it dodges a timed burst/all-in commit.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags rule untargetable-dodges-burst for this matchup: Poppy can go untargetable through your commit and you should wait it out rather than spend everything into it. The existing spikes[1] text also mischaracterizes her R as something that 'cancels a dash', which the kit text does not support (it's a channel, not a dash-interrupt tool).
audit.corrected: Rewrote spikes[1].text to state the real interaction: her R makes her untargetable mid-channel, so hold your combo rather than dump it in.
